package.name: diy_waypoint_sequencer
package.description: Standalone, optional automated goal-pose sequencer for the custom A* + PD/pure-pursuit navigation stack (diy_planning / diy_motion_planner). Publishes /goal_pose in sequence from a simple waypoints YAML, advancing on /pd/goal_reached. Deliberately has ZERO dependency on diy_zone_nav — if this node isn't run, /goal_pose can still be published manually (RViz "2D Goal Pose", or ros2 topic pub) with no code changes anywhere else in the stack. See docs/reuse_plan_step1.md for the design rationale.
